qualified: Complete operative model-license text and incorporated terms are reviewed to assign an O1--O4 category; metadata identifies a candidate for review but does not alone establish material scope.
not_qualified: Applicable model terms are missing or unresolved, including when incorporated terms cannot be reviewed.

qualified: Reviewed model terms expressly cover release-relevant code, or release-bound evidence establishes qualifying component-specific terms.
not_qualified: Applicable code terms are missing, unresolved, exclude the relevant code or studied use, or leave material scope unclear.

qualified: Target-relevant data has release-bound license or use-terms evidence, or full-text review shows that the assigned model license explicitly covers the data. Separate data terms qualify only when they are release-bound.
not_qualified: No data-license or data-use-terms evidence, observed terms exclude the data, or the data source/license relationship is unclear.
